name: crinaro-marketplace
description: General-purpose Claude Code plugins from Crinaro — not pinned to one vertical. Currently: a job-search assistant that helps a person find their next role (and a small agency support several people doing the same), and a connector for working across several Gmail accounts at once.

plugins.name: gmail-multi
plugins.description: Search, read, draft and send across several Gmail accounts at once; the managed Gmail connector binds to one. Results are tagged with their mailbox, and attachments can be fetched. Every call names its account (`all` searches every registered one). Every send, reply or forward asks you first and is refused when nobody is present. Configure accounts with /gmail-multi:accounts; app passwords stay in the OS credential store. Use it whenever mail spans more than one Google account.

plugins.name: jobsearch
plugins.description: A job-search assistant: sweeps your mailbox and LinkedIn for replies and interview invitations, screens roles against your own compensation floors and geography, tracks every application and conversation, and drafts outreach in your voice. It never sends anything itself.
